answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The resilience comes from slashing: dishonest approval costs more than the gain from a single manipulated verdict, so rational attackers stay honest. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock. Consider a summit as the anchor of the cost.
